title: Faith, Hope, and Love, Now Dwell on Earth
description: Faith, Hope, and Love, Now Dwell on Earth in Tonic Solfa to ST. FLAVIAN, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 2 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 387 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Faith, Hope and Charity”, where the book credits them to the Christian Psalmist.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. FLAVIAN; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Faith, hope, and love, now dwell on earth, And earth by them is blest; But faith and hope must yield to love, Of all the gra-ces best.

lines: Faith, hope, and love, now dwell on earth,
And earth by them is blest;
But faith and hope must yield to love,
Hope shall to full fruition rise,
These are the means, but this the end,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. FLAVIAN by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
